settings.title: Settings
settings.accessibilityHint: Optional. More reliable blocking, but requires the Accessibility permission.
settings.nearbyHint: While focus mode is on, your phone announces over Bluetooth that it uses Focus and looks for others. No name or location is sent. If someone is found you get a notification, and you see their details only after you accept.

settings.bluetoothMissing: Without the Bluetooth permission this does not work.
settings.nicknameBlocked: This nickname is not allowed. Please choose another.
settings.nicknameChars: Allowed: Latin letters, digits, space, dot, underscore and hyphen.

onboarding.welcomeBody: When focus mode is on, only the apps you allowed in advance stay available. Everything else is hidden or blocked. Your data stays on this phone: no account, no ads.

usageAccess.title: Usage access
usageAccess.why: We need to know which app is in the foreground so a non-allowed one can be blocked.

overlay.title: Display over other apps
overlay.why: This lets us show the blocking screen on top of a non-allowed app.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.why: Android requires a persistent notification while focus mode runs. We send no other notifications.

batteryOptimization.title: Battery optimization exemption
batteryOptimization.why: So the system does not stop focus mode while you are focusing.

defaultLauncher.title: Default home app (optional)
defaultLauncher.why: Optional. The Home button then goes straight to the focus screen. It also works without it, with a slightly longer flash.

exactAlarm.title: Exact alarms
exactAlarm.why: So scheduled sessions start exactly on time, even when the app is closed.

accessibility.title: Accessibility service
accessibility.why: We use it only to learn the name of the app that is in the foreground, so a non-allowed app can be replaced by the focus screen right away. We do not read screen content, text or passwords, and nothing is sent anywhere; it all stays on the phone. Focus mode cannot start without it.

screenTime.title: Screen Time
screenTime.why: Apple requires your consent before we can restrict apps. Your selection stays on the device.

notificationAccess.title: Notification access
notificationAccess.why: While focus mode is on we dismiss notifications from apps that are not allowed, so the phone only shows what you permit. We read only the name of the app that sent a notification, never its text, and nothing is sent anywhere.

bluetooth.title: Bluetooth
bluetooth.why: While focus mode is on, your phone broadcasts and looks for other Focus users. It does not send your name or location, only a random code that changes every midnight. If it finds someone you get a notification you can accept or decline, and you see their details only after accepting. Bluetooth is not used to find your location. Optional; you can turn it off in Settings.

progress.title: Progress

progress.nearbyEmpty: No one yet. When you are both in range with focus mode and Bluetooth on, you get a notification.
